# Lab 11.4: Continuous Query → BigQuery & Iceberg Tables

## What We Are Going to Do
Run a continuous query that enriches each new ride and inserts it into another BigQuery table, then do the same into an Iceberg table.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Create the target table.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE lab11.rides_enriched (
  ride_id STRING, city STRING, fare FLOAT64, fare_per_km FLOAT64, fare_band STRING, ride_ts TIMESTAMP
);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Start the continuous INSERT.** In continuous query mode with the service account:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">INSERT INTO lab11.rides_enriched
SELECT
  ride_id, city, fare,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(fare, distance_km), 2) AS fare_per_km,
  CASE WHEN fare &gt; 150 THEN 'high' WHEN fare &gt; 50 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'low' END AS fare_band,
  ride_ts
FROM APPENDS(TABLE lab11.rides, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[CLI] Generate rides and check.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">./gen_rides.sh
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'SELECT fare_band, COUNT(*) FROM lab11.rides_enriched GROUP BY fare_band'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Iceberg target.** Create an Iceberg table (as in Lab 10.4), then point a second continuous query at it:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE lab11.rides_iceberg (ride_id STRING, city STRING, fare FLOAT64, ride_ts TIMESTAMP)
WITH CONNECTION `YOUR_PROJECT.us.lab_conn`
OPTIONS (file_format = 'PARQUET', table_format = 'ICEBERG', storage_uri = 'gs://YOUR_BUCKET/iceberg/rides');</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">INSERT INTO lab11.rides_iceberg
SELECT ride_id, city, fare, ride_ts
FROM APPENDS(TABLE lab11.rides, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Cancel both continuous queries** when you are done.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Continuous INSERT | Enriched rows appear within seconds |
| Logic | Any row-level SQL (no aggregations across rows) |
| Iceberg target | Open-format copy kept up to date |
| Jobs | Cancel when finished |
